description: World zone registry used by WorldScene and ZoneManager. Supported zone types are documented here so future fields, towns, dungeons, and story-only spaces can be added without hardcoding zone_1.

zoneTypeDescriptions.field: Open combat/exploration zone with normal monsters and field presence.
zoneTypeDescriptions.town: Safe social/vendor/crafting zone with little or no combat.
zoneTypeDescriptions.story: Narrative or prologue-only scene space with controlled movement/combat.
